capabilities: Scan QR codes and barcodes in images embedded or linked in a note
Scan the image open in the current tab or an image file from its menu
Insert decoded text into the note as code spans, a fenced block or a callout
Copy decoded text to the system clipboard
Choose a scan profile that sets how long the engine searches
extras: Runs fully offline with no account, no network requests and no data collection; the manifest allows mobile. main.js is about 3 MB because the WebAssembly engine is embedded, and a scan holds Obsidian while it runs (about half a second on a recent Mac). Decoded text is written inside code spans so links, embeds or HTML in a code stay plain text.
problem: Obsidian cannot decode the QR codes and barcodes that appear in images saved in a vault, so their text has to be retyped by hand.
summary: Reads QR codes and barcodes in images stored in a vault with an on-device WebAssembly engine and inserts the decoded text into a note.
